output.name: Streakly
output.description: Streakly is an iOS habit tracker that lets you repair missed days within the week — no more broken streaks. Weekly targets replace daily guilt, and all data stays private on-device. 41% of beta users still tracked at day 30.
output.first_comment: I built Streakly because I kept quitting habit apps the moment I missed a day. One slip broke the streak, the motivation vanished, and I deleted the app. Streakly fixes that: if you miss a day, just double up within the week and your streak survives. It scores habits against weekly targets, not unbroken chains, based on behavior-change research. Everything is private — no accounts, no social feed, no shame. We ran a TestFlight with 800 people: 41% were still tracking at day 30, and we got a 4.8-star average. The most-requested feature — streak repair — is the core mechanic, not a paid upgrade. Currently free in beta; premium tier planned at $29/year. Would love feedback on what motivates you to keep going after a miss, and whether weekly scoring feels more realistic than daily streaks.
